prop:carrier-reality-adjoint.scope: The involution and no-positive-functional obstruction are proved in the explicit two-character algebra C x C. The quotient-algebra isomorphism and Hilbert-representation corollary remain.

thm:optimized-selected-lines.scope: Finite independent-line product domination is checked. The massless four-dimensional radial/Gamma identity, inverse-moment implication, affine routing Jacobian and full anisotropic sum remain.

prop:residual-coercivity.scope: Linear coercivity, signed affine-shift control and polynomial-exponential integrability are checked for natural polynomial degree. The full-rank/singular-value certificate, real degrees, and quadratic case remain.

prop:OQED-moment-certificate.scope: Normalization at zero and the elementary exponential envelope are checked. The probability density, subordination, all inverse moments, Bessel formulas and exponential-moment endpoint remain.

thm:OQED-fixed-graph.scope: A sufficient subclass with a polynomial bound times the normalized kernel of the full loop norm is checked. Deriving this complete-integrand bound from routed propagators and actual completed vertices remains.

lem:OQED-grouped-convergence.scope: The real-valued finite sum is absolutely integrable and has an exhaustion-independent integral under its supplied common envelope. Holomorphic continuation and action/routing identification remain.

ass:OS-completion.scope: Physical reconstruction is an explicit assumption in the source; it has not been established or encoded as a project axiom.

ass:cut-matching.scope: Cut-discontinuity compatibility is an explicit assumption in the source; it has not been established or encoded as a project axiom.
